offers_products.reason: Sells ocean transport and port logistics, not goods; the cargo belongs to customers.

offers_services.reason: Dry bulk shipping, stevedoring, and port design and operation done for clients.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are commercial shippers of dry bulk cargoes such as ores and DRI.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Charters and carries bulk cargo for industrial and commodity customers, and builds port projects for them.

recurring_revenue.reason: Mostly voyage and spot charters, plus some contracts of affreightment; project-style work.

cyclical_demand.reason: Dry bulk freight demand and rates swing with global trade and commodity cycles.

big_ticket.reason: Voyages are frequent, routine freight shipments, not rare one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from its owned fleet of bulk carriers, not mainly from staff time.

large_customers.reason: Serves large mining, steel and commodity companies that ship bulk cargoes.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns or partly owns about 40 bulk carriers, including ice-class vessels, and invests in port terminals.

notes: Recurring revenue is a judgment call: a mix of voyage charters and contract-of-affreightment work with repeat industrial customers.
